title: Top-Selling Product in Each Region
description:
Find the **single best-selling product** (by total quantity sold) in each region. If there is a tie, return the one that comes first alphabetically by product name.

**Table: sales** — `sale_id`, `product_name`, `region`, `quantity`

Output columns: `region`, `product_name`, `total_qty`. Order by `region`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INTEGER, product_name VARCHAR, region VARCHAR, quantity INTEGER); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1,'Widget A','North',30),(2,'Widget A','North',20),(3,'Gadget B','North',30),(4,'Doohickey C','North',20),(5,'Gadget B','South',40),(6,'Gadget B','South',20),(7,'Widget A','South',25),(8,'Thingamajig D','South',15),(9,'Doohickey C','East',45),(10,'Widget A','East',30),(11,'Gadget B','East',20),(12,'Thingamajig D','East',10);
solution_sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT region, product_name, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM sales GROUP BY region, product_name), ranked AS (SELECT region, product_name, total_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_qty DESC, product_name ASC) AS rn FROM agg) SELECT region, product_name, total_qty FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY region;

test_cases.description: North: Widget A=50 wins; South: Gadget B=60 wins; East: Doohickey C=45 wins

hints: First aggregate total quantity per (region, product_name) in a CTE.
Then apply ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_qty DESC) to rank within each region.
Filter for rn = 1 to keep only the top product per region.
explanation: After aggregating: North totals — Widget A=50, Gadget B=30, Doohickey C=20 (Widget A wins). South totals — Gadget B=60, Widget A=25, Thingamajig D=15 (Gadget B wins). East totals — Doohickey C=45, Widget A=30, Gadget B=20 (Doohickey C wins). ROW_NUMBER partitioned by region picks one winner per region.
